description: Read the Chinese almanac (通勝, 黃曆) for 1 to 31 consecutive days: lunar date, year, month and day pillars, any solar term with its local time, the activities listed as suitable (宜) and to avoid (忌) with English glosses, the day's clash, the twelve officers, the day god and the auspicious double hours. No birth data needed.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in timezone.

timezone.description: IANA zone used for 'today' and for the local time of any solar term.

name: get_almanac
title: Read the Chinese almanac
